facts.name: Celandine Poppy
facts.notes: Cheery yellow poppies over lobed leaves in spring, with a few more later. Reseeds into shady corners. Not the invasive lesser celandine.
facts.toxSrc: Poppy family; the orange sap contains alkaloids (general references; not on the ASPCA list)

credit.file: Stylophorum diphyllum - woodland poppy - desc-flower open.jpg

companions.why: Combines with bleeding heart and celandine poppy; hosta, astilbe, bugbane, Solomon's seal or ferns fill the gap after it goes dormant.

sources.title: Wisconsin Horticulture (UW–Madison Extension): Virginia Bluebells article

companions.why: Found with Solomon's seal, ferns, mayapple and woodland phlox; combines with celandine poppy, columbine, foamflower and goat's beard.
